body: Reported against 0.10.1. vendor_tree() copies the tree the tests run from and two refusal tests use AGENTS.md as the "setup left the checkout intact" marker, but AGENTS.md is a dev-only file absent from vendored installs, so the tests fail there (193 pass, 2 fail). Fix: vendor_tree() creates the marker file itself; this also makes test_vendored_install's "AGENTS.md was removed" assertion meaningful outside the upstream checkout.
title: TestSetupScript fails in a vendored install: two tests expect AGENTS.md
